abandoned.description: False when the entry was already abandoned.

BasedOn.description: The snapshot a client planned against.

Change.description: One field change of an existing task.

oneOf.description: `None` clears the notes.
`None` removes the due date.
`None` removes the start date.

Set the repeat rule, or `None` to remove it. A task without a due date must get one
first (a `Change::Due` earlier in the same list): 2Do makes the due date today.

Turn the task into a task, checklist or project. A single-resource edit of the task's
own metadata: whether its items allow it is the gate's call.

CheckReport.description:
What `check.report` answers: the lines to print on stdout and the warnings to print on
stderr (the client adds `tdo: `).

CheckReportParams.description:
Params of `check.report`: the report `tdo check` prints, or with `uid` the permissions of
one task (`tdo op check`).

matrix.description: A compatibility matrix file (a test hook); the daemon's own matrix when absent.

uid.description: Report the one task with this UID instead of the whole collection.

verbose.description: Include task titles and parse-error paths.

daemon.description:
Never on the wire: a client one release older rejects keys it does not know. It
travels as `WireSnapshot.unit_warning`.

error.description:
Why the last change to the file was not applied (unreadable, invalid); the last good
configuration stays in force.

restart_needed.description:
Binding settings the file now names differently (`vdir`, `state_dir`, `writes`,
`sync`); they apply only after the daemon restarts.

current.description: The task as the vdir holds it now; `None` when its file is absent.

vdir_file.description: Absolute path of the task's file in the vdir.

choice.description: The side chosen, once a held conflict has one (applied on the next sync).

held.description: True while vdirsyncer still keeps the two sides apart: only local or remote can be kept.

path.description: Vdir-relative path of the task's file.

title.description: The task's `SUMMARY` from either version (local first); absent when neither has one.

DaemonPrefs.description: `[daemon]` table: preferences about the daemon that clients act on.

unit_warning.description: Warn in the TUI while no service unit is installed.

DeletedBackupView.description: A backup a list deletion kept.

Due.description:
A due date. `Time` is floating local time (`DUE:YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS`, no `TZID`), as 2Do
writes it (H8).

Empty.description: An empty params or result object.

oneOf.description: A sync began (a `sync.run` job's, or a background one without a `job_id`).

A sync ended; sent after its changes are published (`status_rev` is the status after
it).
A job ended; `job.get` returns the same state later.

ExportResult.description:
What `export` answers: the schema v1 document `tdo export-json` prints, and how many
resources the read could not parse.

document.description: schema v1, as read by tools/reconcile.py

skipped.description: Resources that failed to parse and are missing from `document`.

ForgetPreview.description: What forgetting a list would preserve.

pending.description: Edits of the list that are not yet synced.

IcalDateTime.description: A DATE / DATE-TIME value as written, before any timezone resolution.

InputField.description:
Which field `input.parse` reads text for.

Clients send this value and the daemon reads it, so it is a closed enum: a daemon that
does not know a field answers `invalid` through the ordinary params check.

InputParseParams.description:
Params of `input.parse`: typed text of a date or repeat field, read with the grammar the
TUI uses.

anchor.description:
The date a repeat description follows (the task's due date, else today); defaults to
none. Only the repeat field reads it.

today.description: The day "today" means; defaults to today in the configured time zone.

InputParsed.description:
Result of `input.parse`. Empty text clears the field: `cleared` is true and the rest is
empty. A date field fills `due` (for `start` too: it is the date the field takes).

description.description: The preview line the TUI shows under the field.

Instance.description: Which configuration and vdir a client means; checked by `hello`.

JobGetParams.description: Params of `job.get`: exactly one of the two.

oneOf.description:
A list was created, changed, archived, unarchived or reconciled; `operation` is the
list operation's id (empty for a local archive change).
`lists.preview_delete` saved a backup.
`lists.export` copied backup `backup` to `destination`.

`lists.delete` (or the reconcile of an interrupted one) removed collection `collection`
from the server; `backup` is the verified backup kept, and the local copy is retired.

`lists.forget` preserved list `name` as `backup`; `message` is what the TUI shows
(with the sync's problems appended), `sync` the sync that followed.
`lists.recover` copied a backup into a list (`applied`), or found it already copied.

JobStarted.description: The answer of a job method.

oneOf.description: The daemon stopped before the job ended (it was queued or running).

JournalEntryView.description: One journal entry, as `tdo op journal` lists it.

request_id.description: The client request behind the entry, if one made it.

synced.description: When a sync confirmed the server holds the entry's result.

JournalRevertParams.description:
Params of `journal.revert`: undoes the applied entry `op_id`, whoever wrote it. The revert
is not on any session's undo stack.

ListArchiveParams.description: Params of `lists.archive` and `lists.unarchive`: the list as the client saw it.

ListDeleteParams.description: Params of `lists.delete`: the preview the client showed.

ListExportParams.description: Params of `lists.export`: copy backup `backup` to the new directory `destination`.

ListForgetParams.description:
Params of `lists.forget`: the list `name` as the preview showed it; the job fails when
`name` now resolves to another directory than `collection`.

ListPreviewForgetParams.description: Params of `lists.preview_forget`: the list to forget, by directory or display name.

ListReconcileParams.description:
Params of `lists.reconcile`: finish the unfinished list operation `operation`, or, with
`keep_server`, adopt what the server holds.

ListRecoverParams.description:
Params of `lists.recover`: copy the tasks of retired-list backup `backup` into the
existing list `to`.

ListUpdateParams.description:
Params of `lists.update`: the new name and colour of the list `expected` describes as the
client saw it.

oneOf.description:
`<2Do Meta>` JSON. It is the full field set, so a missing field means "not set"
(for example no `StartDate` = no start date, whatever DTSTART says).

Metadata.description: Parsed metadata. `tokens` maps key to `Some(value)` or `None` for a bare flag.

unreadable.description: The value looked like `<2Do Meta>` JSON but did not decode; `tokens` is empty.

Missed.description: Params of the `missed` notification: events were dropped; refetch from these marks.

parent.description: iCalendar UID of the checklist or project this task is an item of.

repeat.description: Needs a due date (checked when the task is built).

Op.description: A write operation on the task store.

oneOf.description: Candidate-only explicit membership change; collection is always a list id.

The edit form's save: `changes` to the task, then a move to list `to`, as one journal
entry and one undo step. Either part may be empty (no changes, `to` = `None`).

spec.description: The rule in the form `Op` takes (`repeat` of a `set` or a `create`).

PendingListOp.description: An unfinished list save (`lists.pending`), as the TUI's reconcile card needs it.

observed_color.description: The colour the server reported, when the record has it.

observed_name.description: The name the server reported, when the record has it.

operation.description: The operation record's id (`lists.reconcile` takes it).

Placement.description: A write operation on the task store.

unknown.description: Parts Twydo does not interpret, kept as written (key uppercased).

resumed.description: Ids of the entries rolled forward to applied.

RepeatSpec.description: A repeat rule plus 2Do's "from completion" flag (which is not part of the RRULE).

message.description: The confirmation, in the words `tdo conflicts resolve` uses.

conflicts.description: The list had unresolved conflicts when it was preserved.

destination.description: The list a recovery of this backup went to, once one was recorded.

config.description: The state of `config.toml` as the daemon reads it live; omitted while all is well.

drain_error.description:
Why the last drain of the write queue stopped with items left (a stuck journal, an
I/O error); retried when the next long job ends. `None` when the last drain finished
or only found the vdir held by another process.

queue_unreadable.description:
Queue item files that do not parse (paths): they are not drained and not shown as
pending; the user decides what to do with them.

StuckView.description: An entry recovery could not finish.

SyncConfig.description: `[sync]` table. Absent means sync is off.

batch_size.description: Unsynced edits that make a sync due.

ca_file.description: PEM file with the CA that signed the server certificate.

list_python.description: Python interpreter containing the supported vdirsyncer collection adapter.

local_storage.description: vdirsyncer storage name of the vdir side of the pair.

max_wait_secs.description: Seconds after the oldest unsynced edit at which a sync is due.

password_command.description: Command (argv) that prints the CalDAV password; run by vdirsyncer.

oneOf.description: The run did nothing (another runner held the run lock, sync is not configured, ...).

SyncResult.description: What a sync did, in the words `tdo sync` uses.

drained.description: Queued edits the sync dealt with (each also gets its `op.finished`).

notes.description: What the runner did on its own.

problems.description: What the user should act on (`tdo sync` prints them after `tdo: `).

warnings.description: What did not fail the run (`tdo sync` prints them after `tdo: warning: `).

discover.description:
Look for lists created on the server before syncing (`:discover` and `tdo sync --discover`
ask for it; a daemon does it by itself at startup). Absent means no.

force_delete.description:
Lists to sync with `--force-delete` (directory or display names), as
`tdo sync --force-delete`.

auto.description:
The switch the call set: `true` is automatic sync on. It repeats the request's `on`;
it is not read back from the switch file.

message.description: The confirmation, in the words `tdo sync on|off` uses.

stopping.description: False when no sync ran in this daemon, so there was nothing to stop.

collections.description: The last reported state of each list, by directory name.

discovery_error.description: Why the last list discovery failed, when it did.

job_id.description: The job of the running sync (a `sync.run`); absent for a background sync.

metasync_error.description: Why the last list-metadata sync failed, when it did.

VersionView.description: The fields `tdo conflicts show` prints of one version of a task.

file.description: Absolute path of the kept copy; absent for the current version, whose path is `vdir_file`.

WireCollState.description: The last reported sync result of one list.

WireConflictKind.description: What kind of disagreement a conflict is (mirrors the core's `ConflictKind`).

WireConflictState.description: Where a conflict is in its life (mirrors the core's `ConflictState`).

WireDeletePreview.description: What `lists.preview_delete` saved: the backup that a deletion would keep.

oneOf.description: The task as the vdir holds it now (not for a held conflict).

WireListState.description: A list as the list methods see it: its name, colour and local archive flag.

color.description: `#rrggbb`; absent when the list has no colour.

id.description: The list's directory name in the vdir.

WireResolution.description: What a resolution did (mirrors the core's `Resolution`).

oneOf.description: A held conflict: the choice is recorded and the next sync applies it.
The vdir already held the kept version.
The kept version was written to the vdir (`op_id` names the journal entry).
The conflict is closed and the vdir file left as it is.

WireSide.description: Which copy of a task (mirrors the core's `Side`).

unit_warning.description:
`daemon.unit_warning` of the configuration, which is not serialised inside `config`
(an older client would reject the key). Absent means `true`.

WireStage.description: Where a journal entry is in its life (mirrors the core's `Stage`).

blocked.description: Reason edits must stay off for this task.

WriteMode.description:
`verified` runs only operations the compatibility matrix passes; `test` also runs
unverified ones and must only be used against the isolated test account.
